# CallProof Vault

Product key: callproof-vault
Canonical product: https://call-proof-vault.base44.app/
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/callproof-vault/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/callproof-vault/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- organize my robocall evidence
- make an FCC complaint packet
- help me document spam calls
- prepare my FTC call evidence
- track repeated unwanted calls or texts
- build a factual unwanted-call incident timeline

## Authority

public product and offer discovery with authenticated handoff for private evidence and checkout

## Commercial state

- Status: authenticated_handoff_required
- Offer: Stop-The-Calls Packet · $19 one-time
- Offer: Vault · $7.99/month
- Offer: Pro · $29/month
- Payment state: Authentication required; live Stripe plan at checkout is authoritative and payment must be independently verified

## Boundaries

- CallProof is an evidence-organization tool, not a law firm and not legal advice
- it does not determine that a caller violated the TCPA or another law
- it does not automatically file an FCC or FTC complaint
- private call logs, phone numbers, notes, screenshots, voicemails and billing records are never public discovery data
- the live Stripe price attached to the selected plan is authoritative at checkout
